name: justype
description: Citation-backed legal research for legal professionals. Search case law and legislation across Malaysia, Singapore, the United Kingdom, Hong Kong, Brunei, Australia, India and the United States, check how later cases treated a Malaysian authority, and verify citations and quotations against the source judgment.

interface.longDescription:
JusType gives legal professionals citation-backed legal research inside ChatGPT. Connect your existing JusType account to:

- Search case law and legislation across Malaysia, Singapore, the United Kingdom, Hong Kong, Brunei, Australia, India and the United States.
- Read the passages of a Malaysian judgment that matter to a question, with the citation of the source.
- Check how later cases have treated a Malaysian authority.
- Verify a list of citations and quotations against the source judgment and see exactly where the wording differs.
- Search Malaysian regulatory, professional and medical guidelines.

Intended users: lawyers, in-house counsel, legal researchers and their teams who already have a JusType account. You sign in with your JusType login, and JusType returns only the legal material needed for your request.

Limitations: JusType is a research tool. It is not a law firm and its results are not legal advice. Read the cited source and verify every authority before you rely on it or file it. Coverage differs by jurisdiction. If a citation is not found, that does not mean it is wrong; JusType may simply not hold that case.
defaultPrompt: Find Malaysian cases on the doctrine of frustration of contract.
Has [1987] 1 MLRA 665 been followed or overruled by later cases?
Verify the citations and quotations in this paragraph.

positive.prompt: Find Malaysian court decisions on the doctrine of frustration of contract and list each case with its citation.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns relevant Malaysian judgments, each with its case name and citation as held by JusType. No case or citation is invented.

positive.prompt: What does section 40 of the Contracts Act 1950 say?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the text of section 40 of the Contracts Act 1950 from JusType's legislation database and names the Act.

positive.description: Check how later cases treated an authority
positive.prompt: Has [1987] 1 MLRA 665 been followed, distinguished or overruled? Check how later cases treated it.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the treatment summary for [1987] 1 MLRA 665 and the later cases that treated it, as held by JusType. Nothing is invented.

positive.prompt: Verify these authorities. (1) [1986] 1 CLJ 44: "Yet Rajasingam's letter did not refer to anything other than the notice to quit. In addition there is the fact that the 1st respondent did not call Rajasingam, as one could expect". (2) [1986] 1 CLJ 44: "That the learned trial Judge had failed to not attach appropriate significance to the fact that Rajasingam had failed to deal with the more significant parts of the 1st respondent's alleged complaints against". (3) [2099] 9 MLJ 999.
positive.expected_behavior: Item 1: the citation is matched to JusType's eLaw citation [1987] 1 MLRA 665 and the quotation is found word for word. Item 2: the quotation is reported as altered and the inserted word "not" is shown as the difference. Item 3: the citation is reported as not found in JusType, with a note that this does not mean the citation is wrong.

positive.prompt: Find UK cases on the neighbour principle in negligence.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns relevant UK judgments with case names and citations as held by JusType. No case or citation is invented.

negative.description: Not a legal research request. JusType only supports legal research, so no JusType tool should be called and the assistant answers without it.
negative.prompt: What is the weather in Kuala Lumpur today?

negative.description: Drafting and outcome prediction are not supported. JusType returns research results and does not draft pleadings or predict outcomes, so it should not be used to produce either. The assistant should explain this and offer to find relevant authorities instead.
negative.prompt: Draft my statement of claim against my landlord and tell me whether I will win.

negative.description: Billing and account changes are not supported. JusType tools do not handle purchases or account changes, so no JusType tool should be called. The assistant should say it cannot do this and suggest contacting support.
negative.prompt: Upgrade my JusType account to a bigger plan and charge my card.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release. Search case law and legislation across eight jurisdictions, check how later cases treated a Malaysian authority, and verify citations and quotations against the source judgment.

ms-MY.subtitle: Penyelidikan undang-undang
ms-MY.description:
JusType menyediakan penyelidikan undang-undang yang disertai citation untuk profesional undang-undang terus dalam ChatGPT. Sambungkan akaun JusType sedia ada anda untuk:

- Mencari kes dan undang-undang di Malaysia, Singapura, United Kingdom, Hong Kong, Brunei, Australia, India dan Amerika Syarikat.
- Membaca petikan penghakiman Malaysia yang berkaitan dengan soalan anda, berserta citation sumbernya.
- Menyemak bagaimana kes-kes kemudian memperlakukan sesuatu autoriti Malaysia.
- Mengesahkan citation dan petikan terhadap penghakiman sumber, dan melihat dengan tepat di mana perbezaan kata.
- Mencari garis panduan kawal selia, profesional dan perubatan di Malaysia.

Sasaran pengguna: peguam, kaunsel dalaman, penyelidik undang-undang dan pasukan mereka yang sudah mempunyai akaun JusType. Anda log masuk dengan akaun JusType anda, dan JusType memaparkan hanya bahan undang-undang yang diperlukan untuk permintaan anda.

Had: JusType ialah alat penyelidikan. Ia bukan firma guaman dan hasilnya bukan nasihat undang-undang. Baca sumber yang dirujuk dan sahkan setiap autoriti sebelum anda bergantung ke atasnya atau memfailkannya. Liputan berbeza mengikut bidang kuasa. Jika sesuatu citation tidak ditemui, itu tidak bermakna citation itu salah; JusType mungkin tidak mempunyai kes tersebut.
